description: List an item's QA questions. The questions put to QA on a queue item, newest first (max 100), each with QA's answer once given. `ops get` returns the same list as `qaQuestions`.

handle.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

status.description: Where a QA question stands: `open` (waiting on QA) or `answered`.

name: ops_qa_questions_list
